title: Governance: golden renders, browser matrix and a staging tenant
description: Why: one renderer couples every site to every release. Catch regressions before a tenant does.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Governance tasks for the shared tier: PPY-f7ce77 (release gate on the adversarial suite), PPY-4a79f9 (load test with the index-backed home page), PPY-3ff465 (security review gates), PPY-7438d9 (incident runbooks).
